Anya P.: Heads-up — noticed a regression in production around 14:05 UTC. /generate-route p50 token latency jumped ~2.3x for a subset of requests. Traces point to a kernel fallback during long-prefix cases.

Lucas H.: Link? can you drop the dashboard and one example trace?

Anya P.: https://dash.internal/redwood/perf/runs?range=14:00-15:00&route=/generate-route
Example trace id: trace::8a7f9b. Top-level shows big kernel_ms spike at token 12-18.

InfraBot: ALERT: high_token_latency (/generate-route) - 14:07 UTC - p50 120ms -> 280ms :alert:
  summary: kernel fallback observed, auto-sample enabled

Devon: I pushed the kernel selector tweak yesterday (kernel_policy v2). It prefers fp16_accel but falls back to generic_kernel for <seq_len 64 when alignment mismatch occurs. Could be hitting the fallback path for certain prompt shapes.

Maria C.: Also saw increased KV cache evictions around that time. kv_lru_window got bumped to 32 in the same deploy. If we evict prefixes, we miss prefix-KV hits and cause more compute.

Randall S.: We should correlate request_id -> trace -> per-token spans. Current traces only have request-level markers, not subtoken spans. If we tag kernel selection events with request_id + token_index we can build a per-request waterfall.

Lucas H.: Agreed. Wanted panels: p50/p95 token_generate_ms, kernel_ms, kv_lookup_ms, queue_ms per route. Also a "jump to trace" that opens the trace at the request id.

Anya P.: +1 to jump-to-trace. We need to inject a stable x-request-id at the ingress and carry through runtime. Dashboard button should call /traces?request_id=<id>. Must ensure redaction for user prompts (PII).

Devon: Concern: token-level spans add overhead. In our local bench adding per-token tracing increased median by ~1.8% and tail by ~3.5% for small batches. We should sample. Proposal: sample 1% of requests full-token; enable full capture on anomaly (when kernel fallback or eviction rate > threshold).

Maria C.: I built a tiny prototype that emits a compact token timeline. Example payload (compact, newline-delimited):
```
REQ  = 12345 req_id
T0   kernel_select fp16_accel -> generic_kernel
T1   kv_hit prefix:abc key_ms=0.4
T2   kernel_ms token=12 dur_ms=6.2
T3   kernel_ms token=13 dur_ms=8.1
T4   queue_ms dur_ms=2.0
```
We can attach this as a compressed field to traces or push to an events index.

Randall S.: That format looks good and low-overhead. For correlation we need to add a unique trace_link header that the dashboard can consume. Also attach route and model_version tags.

Lucas H.: On dashboard side I'll add per-route KPI cards: tokens_per_sec, token_generate_ms(p50,p95), kv_hit_pct, kernel_fallback_rate. Add a "token waterfall" embedded panel for sampled requests.

Devon: Action plan I propose:
- revert the aggressive kernel fallback in kernel_policy v2 (Devon)
- add sampling instrumentation + compact token timeline (Maria)
- dashboard panels + jump-to-trace (Lucas)
- regression bisect on dataset that triggered it (Anya)

Anya P.: I'll run the bisect today and attach traces to the PR. If we confirm the fallback+kv eviction combo, we roll back the kv_lru_window change too.

InfraBot: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/3456 - "token-timeline + trace-linking (wip)" (author: maria.c)

Maria C.: I also instrumented a small counter: kernel_selector_path{route="/generate-route"} with values: preferred_fp16=72%, fallback_generic=28% during the spike.

Devon: Good data. If fallback hits ~25-30% at peak that's explainable for the latency jump. Lowering kv_lru_window back to 16 might recover prefix hits.

Randall S.: For SLOs we should alert on kernel_fallback_rate > 10% OR kv_eviction_rate > 5% for mission routes. Then auto-enable full tracing for sampled requests.

Lucas H.: I'll prototype the alert rule and add an internal runbook entry: how to flip sampling and how to interpret token-waterfall panels.

Anya P.: Thanks all. TL;DR: kernel fallback + kv eviction combo caused token tail regression. Do small rollback+sampling, add jump-to-trace and token-waterfall in dashboard, run bisect. Assigning owners in the thread. :thumbsup:

Devon: I'll open the rollback PR for kernel_policy and run bench matrix on prod-like inputs. ETA 4h.

Maria C.: I'll iterate on the token timeline schema to make it even smaller (bit-packed) and add a compression test.

Lucas H.: I'll wire the trace-link button to use x-request-id header and add route/model filters.

Anya P.: I'll share bisect results here when done. If anything flakey shows up ping me directly.

InfraBot: Incident note: linked PRs/alerts will post updates to this thread.

Randall S.: Also please capture kernel variant name in traces (e.g., generic_kernel_v1, fp16_accel_v3) so we can roll forward/back reliably.

Anya P.: Noted. Closing loop once rollback validated.
